author: Ankit
problem: tally maps each species on a bird-survey sheet to how many birds were counted. Return the report as a list of lines: one 'species: count' line for each species that was seen, in alphabetical order, followed by a final 'Total: N' line.
bug_description: Copies the whole tally instead of keeping only species with a count above zero, so species that weren't seen get a 'species: 0' line.

comments.accurate: Report of the species that were seen, in alphabetical order, with a total
comments.wrong_behavior: Report listing every species on the survey sheet, in alphabetical order, with a total
comments.wrong_location: Species filtering verified; check that the total counts birds, not species
